goodToKnow.a: Warm layers, even in June. Nights drop close to freezing much of the year. We provide bedding, firewood and torches; you bring clothes, toiletries and anything you cannot sleep without.

goodToKnow.q: Can we play music or bring speakers?
goodToKnow.a: Quiet acoustic around your own fire is fine. Amplified speakers are not. The meadow carries sound further than you think.

goodToKnow.q: Is outside food allowed at the campsite?
goodToKnow.a: Snacks and soft drinks, yes. Cooked food and shisha, no. The kitchen is there for a reason, and the firewood pile is not for shashlik.
The dining area is covered and the tents hold a proper shower. If the forecast turns genuinely bad before you arrive, we move your booking once, free, to the next open night.
